method: ordinary baseline -> evidence status -> three options -> design-team desktop conditional preference -> named professional and affected-public review pending -> expiring spatial permit -> restore or renew
decision_rule: AI may generate and compare options but may not approve, activate, renew, or locate statutory works. This tabletop records design-team desktop conditional preferences only; named professional and affected-public selection remains an unperformed activation gate.
legacy_field_note: The human_decision field is a tabletop schema key for design-team comparison and does not evidence named-professional selection, affected-public review, resident consent, or authorization.

ai_assistance_record.task: Propose and compare three reversible spatial options in each dated public-map research window.
ai_assistance_record.output_scope: candidate descriptions, comparative ranks, and draft permit fields
ai_assistance_record.hard_constraint_rule: ordinary access, registered spatial conflict, missing statutory or engineering evidence, human staffing, and restoration override any AI rank
ai_assistance_record.human_override_rule: the design team may conditionally prefer a lower-ranked option only with an explicit reason; professional and affected-public selection remain pending
